usedFor: tabidoo holds database records, and Google Sheets receives them as rows when “New Record” runs “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in tabidoo, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new record is copied into a sheet, giving you a spreadsheet view of the database.

watchOut: “New Record” in tabidoo is polling, so “Add Multiple Rows” runs after a scheduled check.
